rationale: C22 is the latest displayed instance of a recurring, highly specific annual order designating a named Puerto Rico jurist to act as judge of the United States District Court for Puerto Rico under specified contingencies. The child's title indicates the same individualized acting-judge mechanism for a different jurist in 1958, making C22 a plausible material drafting template. C07 and C06 embody the same form but are earlier versions.

shared_material.child_excerpt: appointing the honorable edward i p tatelman act special judge
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I hereby designate and authorize the Honorable A. Cecil Snyder ... to perform and discharge the duties of the office of Judge of the United States District Court for the District of Puerto Rico ... as acting judge ... during the year 1956.
shared_material.explanation: Both concern an annual designation of a named jurist to serve temporarily as a federal district judge in Puerto Rico; the officeholder and year are adaptable fields within the same administrative mechanism.
